_style_preset: Photorealistic live-action Japanese human drama, contemporary Tokyo (Reiwa era), Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, restrained Japanese film mise-en-scene, no flat lighting

characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. Reference image 1 is the location reference: match its architecture, colours, set dressing and light direction; ignore any borders, labels or wall papers. Nobody holds a phone; NO smartphone in any hand. BODY CONTINUITY LOCKED: ONE complete seated man seen from the SIDE on the sofa — shoulders, chest, arms and hands all physically connected to his body; NO floating arms, NO missing torso, NO see-through body; the frame is cut just below his chin. [CAMERA] eye-level from the side or behind, 50mm lens, f/2.8, natural perspective, rule of thirds, the person's face at least one quarter of the frame height. Insert: only the hands and the object, NO FACE visible, no other people. Photorealistic live-action Japanese human drama, contemporary Tokyo (Reiwa era), Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, restrained Japanese film mise-en-scene, no flat lighting. [CHARACTER] IDENTITY FIRST — only the hands and sleeves of Seo Kentaro: thick weathered hands with a small faded pale burn scar on the back of the RIGHT hand, sleeves of a plain charcoal-grey knit cardigan over a plain grey crew-neck T-shirt, dark trousers, no logo.  [ACTION] Side insert framed below the chin: Kentaro seated on the dark sofa seen from the side, his chest, cardigan and arms continuous down to his scarred hands resting on his knees, trembling slightly, gripping the trouser fabric; no face. [SETTING] Lighting: night, a warm 3200K pendant lamp over the dining table, soft falloff into the dark room, faces readable. All papers, ledgers, screens, signs, cards, keyboards and labels are completely blank (monitors show only a soft plain glow); no letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the frame. [NEGATIVE] gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, signage lettering, documents with writing, screens with text, printed labels, keyboard key letters, brand logos, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people, blood, gore, anime, 3d render, illustration, thick glossy gel tears, cartoon sweat drops, multiple tear streams on both cheeks, earrings on men, apple logo, brand logo on monitors or laptops, LED light strips. The house has NO calendars, NO posters, NO notes with writing on the walls or fridge; all labels blank. CAMERA: from the side or behind — the face in side profile or hidden, NOT facing the camera. Full-frame 16:9 image filling the whole canvas: NO black bars, NO white borders, NO letterbox or pillarbox. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere in the image.
